bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 跌破 10 日均线，测试 $343–346

read.en: Applied Materials fell 5.5% on Nov 16 to $350.25, trading $346.01–358.55. It is below the 5-day ($373.9, still rising), 10-day ($364.3), 30-day ($410.8), 100-day ($484.8) and 200-day ($446.7). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram fading; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($322.11), and RSI is 38.8.

The close lost the 10-day ($364.3), the last written average support, now resistance, and the $346.01 low tested $343–352 (Nov 9 and 13 lows). Resistance is $358.6–364.3, then $370.5–376.1 (5-day, Nov 13 close, Nov 12 low) and $390–397. Support is $343–346, then $332.7 (Nov 6 close) and $317–322 (Nov 5 low, SAR). A close above $364.3 would target $370.5–376; below $343, $332.7.
